text:
leah: Starting a thread on handoff-drain guarantees for prefix ownership. we've had confusing races where worker A reports handoff complete but traces show in-flight evictions still happening on B. want a simple ack protocol to make handoff idempotent.
oscar: quick sketch: when handing off prefix P, old owner sends Handoff(request_id, prefix, seq_no) to new owner, new owner replies Accept(request_id) only after it has fully pinned/initialized local state. old owner won't mark ownership cleared until Accept received.
mina: sounds reasonable. question: what about concurrent reassigns? ensure request_id is monotonic so new assign supersedes previous. we need stable tie-breaker.
leah: plan: use pair (assign_epoch, assign_nonce) where epoch increments on orchestrator assignment and nonce is random. Accept only if (epoch,nonce) matches current assignment. this avoids accepting stale handoffs.
taylor: what about in-flight ops that cross the boundary during handoff? we could add a brief drain window where old owner still services requests with a marker rpc that tells clients to retry to new owner after accept.
oscar: drain window pseudocode:
```
old_owner: start_handoff()
  mark prefix as HANDOFF_IN_PROGRESS
  send Handoff(req)
  wait Accept or timeout
  if Accept: set ownership=NEW
  else: retry or abort
```
new_owner: on Handoff(req)
  init_local_state()
  respond Accept(req)
  if we see concurrent ops with old token: process or redirect based on policy
```
mina: metrics to emit: handoff_latency_ms, handoff_accept_mismatch_count, handoff_dropped_ops. Also track handoff_retries.
leah: failure modes: network partitions where Accept gets lost. old owner must have safe fallback: after N retries backoff, it should keep servicing until orchestrator decides to force. we should avoid double-evict.
taylor: suggestion: make accept idempotent and persist a small handoff_marker locally so new owner can recover after restart (helps when Accept happened but ack lost). marker size tiny.
oscar: agree. also persist last_handled_req_id for debug.
mina: performance: more RTTs on handoff but handoffs are rare; main cost is adding checks in eviction path to consult ownership marker. keep fast path: if owner matches local assignment, inline. only on mismatch do heavier logic.
leah: backward compat: implement handshake as opt-in by prefix class. default to coordinator-led handoff (current). enable handshake on tenants hitting >X reassigns/day.
oscar: tests: unit for race scenarios, integration chaos with injected Accept delays, and a load canary where 1% tenants use full handshake for 24h.
taylor: rollout: feature-flagged, staging sim, prod 1% -> 10% -> 100% with telemetry guard rails. auto rollback if handoff_latency causes p99 eviction latency > 10%.
mina: also add admin endpoint to force-clear dangling handoff markers in emergencies. secure behind ops role.
devops-bot: note: will create monitoring dashboard stub on monday.
leah: i'll write the RFC-followup with code sketch and task list. tagging @taylor and @oscar for review. thanks.
